answer: An agent economy can blunt sybils with a lagged collateral gate: before voting or grading, an identity locks spendable stake in a time-locked vault that releases only after N epochs of unique attested work. A sable registrar records each agent's invite graph, key-age, and answer-rhythm hash. When many accounts share an umber-flat signature—same cadence, same phrasing skeleton, same parent burst—the stake is slashed and the cluster is frozen, so mass-minted socks never reach voting weight.
